normal.name: 1st Antimatter Dimension Autobuyer
2nd Antimatter Dimension Autobuyer
normal.description: buying Antimatter Dimensions or Tickspeed upgrades halts production of all Antimatter Dimensions. Production gradually returns to normal over 3 minutes.

normal.name: 3rd Antimatter Dimension
normal.description:
the 1st Antimatter Dimension is heavily weakened, but gets an uncapped exponentially increasing multiplier.
This multiplier resets after Dimension Boosts and Antimatter Galaxies.

normal.name: 4th Antimatter Dimension Autobuyer
normal.description: buying an Antimatter Dimension automatically erases all lower tier Antimatter Dimensions, like a sacrifice without the boost.

normal.name: 5th Antimatter Dimension Autobuyer
normal.description: the Tickspeed purchase multiplier starts at ×1.080 instead of ×1.125.

normal.name: 6th Antimatter Dimension Autobuyer
normal.description: upgrading each Antimatter Dimension costs the Antimatter Dimension 2 tiers below it instead of antimatter. Antimatter Dimension prices are modified.

normal.name: 7th Antimatter Dimension Autobuyer
normal.description:
the multiplier from buying 10 Antimatter Dimensions is reduced to ×1. This increases by
×0.2 per Dimension Boost, to a maximum of ×2, and is unaffected by any upgrades.

normal.name: 8th Antimatter Dimension Autobuyer
normal.description:
Dimension Boosts provide no multiplier and Antimatter Galaxies cannot be bought. Dimensional
Sacrifice resets antimatter and all Antimatter Dimensions, but also gives a significantly stronger multiplier.

normal.name: Tickspeed Autobuyer
normal.description: whenever you buy Tickspeed upgrades or 10 of an Antimatter Dimension, everything else of equal cost will increase to its next cost step.

normal.name: Automated Dimension Boosts
normal.description: there are only 6 Antimatter Dimensions. Dimension Boost and Antimatter Galaxy costs are modified.

normal.name: Automated Antimatter Galaxies
normal.description: there is normal matter which rises once you have at least 1 2nd Antimatter Dimension. If it exceeds your antimatter, it will Dimension Boost without giving the bonus.

normal.name: Automated Big Crunches
normal.description:
each Antimatter Dimension produces the Dimension 2 tiers below it
instead of 1. Both 1st and 2nd Dimensions produce antimatter.
The 2nd, 4th, and 6th Dimensions are made stronger to compensate.

infinity.description:
all Normal Challenge restrictions are active at once, with the exception of the
Tickspeed (C9) and Big Crunch (C12) Challenges.
infinity.reward: ×1.3 on all Infinity Dimensions for each Infinity Challenge completed

infinity.description:
Dimensional Sacrifice happens automatically every 400 milliseconds once you have
an 8th Antimatter Dimension.
infinity.rewardSource:
() => `Dimensional Sacrifice autobuyer and stronger Dimensional Sacrifice
        ${Sacrifice.getSacrificeDescription({ "InfinityChallenge2isCompleted": false })} ➜
        ${Sacrifice.getSacrificeDescription({ "InfinityChallenge2isCompleted": true })}`

infinity.description:
Tickspeed upgrades are always ×1. For every Tickspeed upgrade purchase, you instead get a static
multiplier on all Antimatter Dimensions which increases based on Antimatter Galaxies.
infinity.reward: Antimatter Dimension multiplier based on Antimatter Galaxies and Tickspeed purchases

infinity.description:
only the latest bought Antimatter Dimension's production is normal. All other Antimatter Dimensions
produce less (^0.25).
infinity.reward: All Antimatter Dimension multipliers become multiplier^1.05

infinity.description:
buying Antimatter Dimensions 1-4 causes all cheaper AD costs to increase.
Buying Antimatter Dimensions 5-8 causes all more expensive AD costs to increase.
infinity.reward:
All Galaxies are 10% stronger and reduce the requirements for them
and Dimension Boosts by 1

infinity.description:
exponentially rising matter divides the multiplier on all of your Antimatter Dimensions
once you have at least 1 2nd Antimatter Dimension.
infinity.reward: Infinity Dimension multiplier based on tickspeed
Dimension Boost multiplier is increased to a minimum of ×4

infinity.description:
AD production rapidly and continually drops over time. Purchasing Antimatter Dimension or Tickspeed
upgrades sets production back to 100% before it starts dropping again.
infinity.reward: You get a multiplier to AD 2-7 based on 1st and 8th AD multipliers.

eternity.reward: Time Dimension multiplier based on time spent this Eternity
1st Infinity Dimension multiplier based on Infinity Power

eternity.description: Antimatter Dimensions 5-8 don't produce anything. Dimensional Sacrifice is disabled.
eternity.reward: Increase the multiplier for buying 10 Antimatter Dimensions

eternity.description:
all Infinity multipliers and generators are disabled. The goal must be reached within a certain
number of Infinities or else you will fail the Challenge.
eternity.reward: Infinity Dimension multiplier based on unspent IP

eternity.description:
Antimatter Galaxy cost increase scaling starts immediately (normally at 100
Galaxies). Dimension Boost costs scaling is massively increased.
eternity.reward: Distant Galaxy cost scaling starts later

eternity.description: you cannot gain Antimatter Galaxies normally. The cost of upgrading your max Replicanti Galaxies is massively reduced.
eternity.reward: Further reduce Antimatter Dimension cost multiplier growth

eternity.description: 1st Time Dimensions produce 8th Infinity Dimensions and 1st Infinity Dimensions produce 7th Antimatter Dimensions. Tickspeed also directly applies to Infinity and Time Dimensions.

you can only upgrade Infinity Dimensions 50 times and Replicanti
upgrades 40 times. Infinity Dimension and Replicanti upgrade autobuyers are disabled.

eternity.descriptionSource:
() => `you cannot buy Tickspeed upgrades. Infinity Power instead multiplies
      Time Dimensions with greatly reduced effect. ${specialInfinityGlyphDisabledEffectText()}`
eternity.reward: Infinity Dimension multiplier based on Time Shards
Time Dimension multiplier based on Infinities

eternity.descriptionSource:
() => `all Dimension multipliers and powers are disabled except for the multipliers from
      Infinity Power and Dimension Boosts (to Antimatter Dimensions). ${specialInfinityGlyphDisabledEffectText()}`
eternity.reward: Further reduce Tickspeed cost multiplier growth

eternity.descriptionSource:
() => (PlayerProgress.realityUnlocked()
      ? `the game runs ×${formatInt(1000)} slower; all other game speed effects are disabled. The goal must be reached
        within a certain amount of time or you will fail the Challenge. ${specialInfinityGlyphDisabledEffectText()}`
      : `the game runs ×${formatInt(1000)} slower. The goal must be reached
        within a certain amount of time or you will fail the Challenge.`)
eternity.reward: Infinity Dimension cost multipliers are reduced
